name: Gemini Computer Use Preview
description: Reference browser agent for the Gemini Computer Use model that completes web tasks from a natural-language query.
whatItDoes: Given an instruction such as a search or form task, the agent operates a browser step by step until the goal is met. It is the official sample for developers evaluating Gemini's computer-use capability.
howItWorks: A Python loop sends screenshots to the Gemini computer-use model and executes the returned UI actions in a browser, either a local Playwright-controlled Chrome or a remote Browserbase session. It can use the Gemini Developer API or Vertex AI.

requirements.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
requirements.description: Gemini API key from Google AI Studio

run: python main.py --query "Go to Google and type 'Hello World' into the search bar"
